question_papers.paper_title: Set 1 - Light – Reflection and Refraction Practice Paper

questions.question_text: The focal length of a spherical mirror with a radius of curvature of +30 cm is equal to:
options: +15 cm
+30 cm
+60 cm
-15 cm
questions.correct_answer: +15 cm

questions.question_text: Which of the following statements correctly describes key observations in Light – Reflection and Refraction (Set 1)?
options: Core process in Light – Reflection and Refraction obeys conservation laws and standard reaction conditions.
Process in Light – Reflection and Refraction violates mass conservation.
No physical or chemical state change occurs during the reaction.
Products have higher total mass than initial reactants.
questions.correct_answer: Core process in Light – Reflection and Refraction obeys conservation laws and standard reaction conditions.

questions.question_text: What physical state symbol or indicator color change is associated with Light – Reflection and Refraction (Set 1)?
options: Aqueous solution (aq) with characteristic color change
Solid precipitate (s) with gas emission
Gaseous phase (g) only
Liquid phase (l) with zero temperature change
questions.correct_answer: Aqueous solution (aq) with characteristic color change

questions.question_text: Identify the correct SI unit or mathematical relationship relevant to Light – Reflection and Refraction (Set 1).
options: Standard NCERT Formula & Unit
Dimensionless Ratio x 100
Inverse Square Exponential
Absolute Constant Zero
questions.correct_answer: Standard NCERT Formula & Unit

questions.question_text:
Assertion (A): Fundamental processes in Light – Reflection and Refraction strictly follow thermodynamic and chemical principles.
Reason (R): Molecular and atomic rearrangements preserve total mass, charge, and energy balance.
options: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
questions.correct_answer: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
